notes.title: 『AI-deal-Rays』 Release!
notes.notes:
[p][b]The high-speed 3D action game "AI-deal-Rays" has officially launched![/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45566702/1aa1f596206a51aa8787c0c29eb0e3b475e69bf1.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Set in the year 2200, witness the story of android AIs and their owners through [b]fast-paced blade action combat[/b].[/p][p]Mirage Line, Cluster Drain, Sonic Burst…[/p][p]Unleash a wide variety of powerful actions and dominate the combat arena.[/p][p][b]You have control.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]👉 Detailed control instructions are available on our [url="https://rinb64th.wixsite.com/riez-on/blog"]official website[/url]—be sure to check them out![/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch, we are holding a [b]20% OFF sale[/b].
We hope you’ll take this chance to experience the world of [i]AI-deal-Rays[/i].[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Welcome to the world of 2200.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]There are other versions of this title with some differences in included content.[/p][p]However, the Steam version features refreshed character graphics, the newly added Burst Select system, enhanced visual effects, and many other exclusive elements.[/p][p]This is a specially tuned version of [i]AI-deal-Rays[/i], optimized for the consumer release.[/p]
